title: UXD Protocol launches
description: UXD Protocol launched its Solana-origin stablecoin and public protocol system in January 2022.
notes: The day-level boundary follows official launch-related documentation.

title: Money on Chain deploys DoC on Rootstock
description: Money on Chain deployed its protocol and Dollar on Chain stablecoin on the Rootstock mainnet.
notes: The date follows Money on Chain's official milestone history.

title: Money on Chain simplifies its protocol model
description: Money on Chain governance implemented a model simplification that removed the BTCX position while preserving the DoC identity and core stability system.
notes: Protocol design changed without creating a new stablecoin identity.

title: DoC expands to Arbitrum
description: Money on Chain launched DoC availability on Arbitrum as a cross-chain expansion of the continuing stablecoin identity.
notes: Rootstock remains the native protocol context; Arbitrum is recorded separately as an additional deployment.
